verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an official hosted MCP server (mcp.secureframe.com) that exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more as MCP tools for both querying and updating data. It works with any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor), uses OAuth sign-in so no secret is stored in config, and offers a headless setup path; a probe confirms an official GitHub repository. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world agent use, and a documented full tool catalog or scope limits.
